Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ritesh Kumar Jha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Arun Kumar Pandey  Mr. Subham Sourav  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 2 17-10-2023

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Siwan Mahila P.S. Case No. 02 of 2023 registered under Sections 341/323/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case for ulterior motive.

Further he submits that prior to the present case, the petitioner has filed Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65659 of 2023(2)
dt.17-10-2023 a divorce case vide Matrimonial Suit No. 179 of 2022 in the Court of learned District Judge.

Further he contended that petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
4. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the concerned court within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of S.D.J.M., Siwan in Mukesh Chaurasiya vs The State Of Bihar on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196736347/
1 connection with Siwan Mahila P.S. Case No. 02 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C. (Arvind Srivastava, J) shailendra/-
